title: Design System: Don't Queue At The Bar

small.purpose: Lowercase captions and asides at 80% opacity.

label.purpose: Uppercase tags, marquee, chart headings and sim scores.

shadows.name: bar-lip
shadows.purpose: Hard counter lip on the sim bar.

shadows.name: mat-offset
shadows.purpose: Flat offset shadow under beer mats.

shadows.name: active-halo
shadows.purpose: Amber ring around the active timeline dot.

motion.name: ease-rise
motion.purpose: Hero rise-in and scroll reveals (0.8 to 0.9s).

motion.name: sim-move
motion.purpose: Sim dots moving along the bar.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Petition submit: amber pill, heavy ink label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: inherit; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.4rem; padding: 0.8em 1em; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffb627; color: #16161d; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff4dc; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Outlined field for dark or coloured screens.
components.css: .ds-input { font: inherit; font-size: 1.2rem; padding: 0.9em 1em; border-radius: 14px; border: 3px solid #fff4dc; background: transparent; color: #fff4dc; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.4); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffb627; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stamp Tag
components.description: Outlined, uppercase, tilted label like a rubber stamp.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0.45em 1.1em; border: 3px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.1rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; rotate: -3deg; }

components.name: Chart Cell
components.description: Alignment chart cell: ink card, amber heading.
components.css: .ds-cell { display: grid; align-content: center; gap: 0.35em; padding: 0.9em 0.7em; min-height: 110px; background: #16161d; color: #fff4dc; border-radius: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.15; text-align: center; } .ds-cell b { color: #ffb627; font-size: 0.85em; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Timeline Dot
components.description: Active chapter dot on the fixed rail, with label.
components.html: 2020 stand on the sticker
components.css: .ds-rail { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 16px 10px; background: rgba(22, 22, 29, 0.9); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.3); border-radius: 999px; color: #fff4dc; } .ds-dot { width: 14px; height: 14px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffb627; border: 2px solid #fff4dc; transform: scale(1.5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(255, 182, 39, 0.35); } .ds-lbl { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.6em; white-space: nowrap; padding: 0.4em 0.9em; background: #16161d; border: 2px solid rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.3); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-lbl small { color: #ffb627; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Marquee
components.description: Ink strip with looping uppercase amber text.
components.html: stand anywhere • find a gap • catch an eye
components.css: .ds-marquee { background: #16161d; color: #ffb627; padding: 0.7em 1em; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.2rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Pub Scene Score
components.description: Sim stage with a big amber pints-served score.
components.css: .ds-scene { position: relative; width: 320px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 11; background: #0e0e13; color: #fff4dc; border: 4px solid rgba(255, 244, 220, 0.9); border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar { position: absolute; left: 4%; right: 4%; top: 14%; height: 5%; background: #c98a3e; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #8a5a22; } .ds-score { position: absolute; right: 4%; bottom: 4%; text-align: right; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-score b { display: block; color: #ffb627; font-size: 2.2rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: A pub noticeboard that has been given a bell and a lab coat. Each screen is one flat sheet of colour carrying one huge lowercase statement, like a poster pinned up and shouted across the room. Underneath the shouting is a deadpan, mock-scientific voice so the design plays the joke straight: loud wrapper, dry contents.
keyCharacteristics: Full-viewport flat colour blocks, one idea each, centred.
Enormous lowercase Avenir-style type at weight 900 with tight tracking.
Chunky, cheerful forms: pills, thick outlines, big radii, tilted stamps.
Pub-night palette used as a rotation of whole screens, not as accents.
Animated dot diagrams on a near-black stage are the only illustration.
Page works without JS and respects prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Whole-Screen Rule
rules.body: Colour is applied to entire screens, never sprinkled as tints on a neutral page. Text on each block is always cream or ink, whichever is the higher contrast.

rules.name: The Red-Is-Wrong, Green-Is-Right Rule
rules.body: Red always belongs to The Single File and green to The Cluster. Do not reuse them as decoration.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is reserved for the thing to look at or press on that screen. If two amber things compete, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Lowercase Shout Rule
rules.body: Headlines are lowercase and enormous. Uppercase is only for labels, the marquee, and the occasional uppercase quote.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Any number that counts up uses tabular numerals so it doesn't jitter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No soft drop shadows, no gradients, no glass. If something needs to stand out, change its colour or scale it up.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: Labels that act as stamps are outlined pills, uppercase, tilted -3deg. Never fill them.

dos: Do give every idea its own full-screen flat colour block and one huge lowercase statement.
Do keep cream and ink as the only text colours; choose by contrast with the block.
Do keep red for The Single File and green for The Cluster.
Do use amber once per screen, for the thing to read or press.
Do keep outlines thick (3 to 4px) and corners chunky (14px to pill).
Do make motion meaningful and short, and honour prefers-reduced-motion with a static fallback.
Do keep the page working without JavaScript.
Do use gender-neutral terms (barperson, bar staff, landlord; they/them) in all visible copy.
Do mark jokes as jokes and keep real, cited figures visually distinct.
donts: Don't use photos or stock imagery; the only illustration is the animated dot diagram and the beer mat art.
Don't use gradients, soft shadows, glass cards or hairline borders.
Don't add small accent colours to a neutral page; colour belongs to whole screens.
Don't introduce web fonts or a second typeface.
Don't shame people or pubs in visuals or copy; tease the behaviour.
Don't put red and green together as decoration, or reuse them away from the Single File and Cluster meanings.
Don't add a chapter without updating both the timeline list and the matching section ids.
